title: In-band video configuration changes with avc3, and qualified hev1

definition.title: In-band video configuration changes with avc3, and qualified hev1
definition.source_excerpt: Question. Can the same destination accept configuration epochs through media samples rather than a new initialization segment each time? What differs from earlier work. Extends R43/R58 but changes the configuration carriage: test whether an in-band epoch removes extra initialization-segment work. Input scope. Initially H.264 with one profile/bit depth and independently decodable resolution-change boundaries; declared level must remain truthful. Mechanism to test. Use legal avc3 parameter-set carriage at random-access boundaries, preserving coded pictures while varying SPS/PPS configuration. Smallest experiment. 1. Compare a known-working avc1/new-init sequence against the properly authored avc3 form. 2. Change dimensions within the admitted profile and seek to both sides. 3. Probe HEVC hev1 separately only on a supported destination.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially changes an eligible file from an expensive/unsupported route to correct native or minimal-transform playback. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.initial_screen: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used. definition.primary_metric: Correct additional admitted source/destination capability; otherwise full startup and CPU/resource cost.
definition.scope_contract: Configuration and ordered codec payloads where copy is intended; requested frames/audio/timeline/features at the declared output boundary.
definition.negative_control: Alter one admission-critical configuration, remove a required dependency, or preserve video while making selected audio unsupported. Candidate must reject or use a declared fallback.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop before a new demuxer, player, codec build family or delivery service is needed. Record precisely which next implementation would unlock the screen.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

screen.basis: Legal source-authored avc3 SPS/PPS epochs change 360p→720p→360p without a second initialization. Independent complete image/seek and continuous-playback checks pass. The declared fresh-owner workload shows10.87% median savings with95% bootstrap interval6.80–17.52%; this is a bounded browser component result, not general HEVC or maintained-route qualification.

correctness.basis: Both fresh-init and in-band-only paths match all72 independent full-frame RGBA hashes/dimensions, five reverse/forward seek queries,71 continuous presented pictures, EOF and cleanup. Truthful same-profile AVC level3.1; actual SPS/PPS/IDR admission rejects a missing-configuration control before mutation. Delayed stale-generation publication is rejected before append. Unchanged AAC lane identity is observed but no PCM continuity claim; no hev1, open-GOP, arbitrary parameters or post-mutation rollback claim.
